n: 400 Series Front Load Washer - 4.5 Cu. Ft.
desc: The Front Load Perfect Steam Washer from Electrolux products range is equipped with LuxCare Wash technology to thoroughly clean clothes for best results. This washer from Electrolux headquarters features a 18-minutes Fast Wash cycle for quick cleaning.
